content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to setting up a [company_name] [product_name] system with SCADA. I managed to create a connection using OI.SIDIR and confirmed its status through the Object Viewer in ArchestrA IDE. I've been provided with several local variable memory bits (such as VBB 0.0, VBB 0.1, etc.), and I'm trying to figure out how to reference these in ArchestrA. Thanks,

It's difficult to assist without additional details about your SCADA system. Each SCADA system uses its own syntax, and compatibility—such as whether a compatible driver exists for communication with a [product_name]—can't be assumed.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble integrating a [company_name] [product_name] with a SCADA platform (ArchestrA IDE) and is specifically seeking guidance on how to reference the memory bits within the SCADA system. The main issue stems from unclear documentation or instructions regarding variable mapping between the [product_name] and ArchestrA, which is especially challenging for newcomers to this type of integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a clear and simple method to assign [product_name] memory bits to variables in ArchestrA IDE to enable effective monitoring and control within their SCADA setup.
